selection_rule: For robust, eligible if each development cell target-reach difference vs fixed_anchor <= +0.01. Among eligible choose minimum mean reach, ties choose higher threshold. If none eligible, selected policy=fixed_anchor. Operational delay > 0 always falls back to anchor for belief/gated/robust.
primary_comparator: fixed_anchor (independent uniformly random initial protected entrance)
secondary_comparator: per-episode arithmetic mean of fixed_A/B/C/D, no hindsight best entrance
holdout_rule: Freeze engine_v2.py, evaluate_v2.py, plan_v2.json hashes and selected threshold before holdout. Use disjoint seed namespaces and report all policies/conditions. No tuning after holdout. Conditions are designed stresses, not real-world unknown attacks.
intervals: Wilson reach CI; paired normal difference CI exploratory; Hoeffding union-bound simultaneous difference intervals over all nontrivial heldout contrasts vs both comparators at family alpha=0.05. Reach difference range [-1,+1].
operating_cost: Report moves and reach + 0.01*moves as descriptive cost only; primary objective stays target reach. Halt on target reach, so episode lengths differ.
